name: Springfield

stay_areas.name: Springfield
stay_areas.best_for: the university quarter raised on the old Springfield Brewery ground
stay_areas.why: Springfield's rooms are the student blocks built over the brewery site, and the School of Architecture and Build Environment supplies the daily traffic that a visitor quarter would otherwise bring.

stay_areas.name: Heath Town
stay_areas.best_for: the ward Springfield belongs to for local government
stay_areas.why: Heath Town is the ward Springfield sits inside, which puts Holy Trinity Church and St Thomas' Church into the same administrative area as the National Brownfield Institute.
